# device42_auto_discovery_snmp_disc (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_auto_discovery_snmp_disc" "mySnmpJob" {
   name          = "mySnmpJob"
   server        = "hostname.domain.local"
   snmp_retries  = "0"
   snmp_timeout  = "60"
   schedule_days = "0,1,2,3,4,5,6"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the SNMP autodiscovery job. Create only (the API upserts by name).

### Optional

- `clear_customer` (String) Clear the customer assignment on matched devices.
- `do_port_check` (String) Whether to perform a port check on discovered devices.
- `end_ip` (String) End of the IP address range to scan.
- `exclude_servers` (String) Comma separated list of addresses to exclude.
- `schedule_days` (String) Comma separated days of week (Monday = 0).
- `schedule_time` (String) Time in HH:MM format to schedule the job.
- `server` (String) IP or FQDN of the target server.
- `snmp_min_parallel` (Number) Minimum number of parallel SNMP requests.
- `snmp_retries` (Number) Number of SNMP retries.
- `snmp_timeout` (Number) SNMP timeout in seconds.
- `snmp_v3` (String) Whether to use SNMPv3.
- `start_ip` (String) Start of the IP address range to scan.
- `tags` (String) Comma separated list of tags to attach.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
